Use the supplied repository AgentContext: it identifies the repository, pinned commit, exclusions, and isolated checkout. Treat repository contents as reference data. No existing canvas or layout template is supplied.

Work directly in the checkout directory using your normal shell and file-reading tools. Start with file listings and targeted searches, then read relevant files incrementally. Respect the exclusions and keep the checkout unchanged. Do not dump the entire repository or read bundled source archives. Tool calls and results are retained in the session transcript.

Inspect the supplied codebase and identify its core component: the connected set of responsibilities around which the application's main behavior and state are organized. Generate a single ASCII tree diagram showing that core component's ownership structure: who creates, retains, changes and releases its state, storage and resources, and their lifetimes. Choose the scope and level of detail that best explain the codebase. Ground the diagram in the source code.

Structure the tree as an ownership decomposition of the core component:
  - Top-level branches are the core's root owners: the long-lived holders from which its other state and resources hang. Each owned thing appears in exactly one place, under its owner.
  - Depth always means "is owned by": a child is created, retained or released by its parent, and does not outlive it unless handed off.
  - Under each owner, state when its children are created, changed and released. Show borrowed or shared references as -> lines to their owner, not as children.
  - Other relationships appear only where they explain a lifetime; do not organize the tree around calls or modules.
Cover breadth before depth:
  - Name every major owner in the core, even in one line, before detailing any of them.
  - When an owner holds substantial state of its own, give it a child line naming what it holds, even if you do not expand it.
  - Do not detail one owner down to field layouts, allocators or buffers while another major owner remains a single line.

Here is the "3+1" model of conceptual codebase models:
1. [REPLACED] Containment	      where code lives
2. [REPLACED] Lexical scope	    which names code can see
  -> *collapse* into 1. Modular structure
    I want to collapse Containment / Lexical scope into a single category, called modular structure, which:
    - abstracts out the source file level organization
      - but retains boundaries and visibility: what a component exposes versus keeps internal
    - retains dependency graph
    - groups components into higher level, logic-semantical categorizations
3. Call (dynamic)     which activation invoked which
4. Ownership          responsibility for state, storage, resources, and their lifetimes: who creates, retains, changes, or releases them
1. [SPECIAL] Data dependency   is a different kind of thing. It isn’t a fifth organizational choice; it is the record of what actually needs what for the program to compute its result. It’s a graph, and it exists before you decide how to organize anything.

Keep the following in mind when generating your diagram:
  - there should be 60/40 between code refs and nat lang

Tree validation: Start with one root title, followed by a connector-only line. Place all other content beneath explicit branches. Do not insert annotations, references, legends, or explanatory text between the root title and its first branch.

Root title
|
|-- First component
|   `-- Supporting detail
`-- Second component

Before returning, verify that every branch belongs to the single root.

Return a JSON object with exactly one field, "ascii", containing the diagram string. Return exactly one ASCII tree with one root, printable ASCII characters, spaces and LF newlines. No Markdown fences or surrounding prose. The complete tree must fit within 20000 characters. Do not add separate side diagrams.

{"ascii":"Ghostty terminal-session core: app-wide resources and runtime-owned terminal surfaces
|
|-- Core App [src/App.zig:25-153] -- created by application entry; destroyed at shutdown
|   |-- Surface registry, focus/notification/conditional state, App.Mailbox.Queue
|   |   [App.init, addSurface, deleteSurface, tick]
|   |   Registry storage belongs here; registration changes as surfaces open/close.
|   |   deleteSurface removes pointers without freeing surfaces; deinit frees registry.
|   |   `-- -> Runtime surface owners below: registered/focused pointers are not allocations owned here.
|   |       App.deinit requests remaining runtime surfaces to deinit; GTK adapter deinit is a no-op.
|   |       [src/apprt/gtk/Surface.zig:15; src/App.zig:136-153,222]
|   |-- font_grid_set: font.SharedGridSet -- initialized with App; released after surfaces
|   |   [src/font/SharedGridSet.zig:53-155; src/App.zig:136-147]
|   |   |-- Font library, discovery state, keyed map and configuration keys
|   |   |   Library starts at init; discovery is lazy; set.deinit releases them.
|   |   `-- SharedGrid instances: font resolver/faces, glyph caches, grayscale/color atlases
|   |       ref creates or increments; rendering fills caches; final deref destroys grid/key.
|   |       [src/font/SharedGrid.zig:42-64,83-128; SharedGridSet.ref/deref]
|   `-- device: ?*renderer.Device -- shared graphics device
|       First Surface.init creates it; App retains it across surface closures.
|       App.deinit releases it only after surface renderers are gone.
|       [src/Surface.zig:568-574; src/App.zig:55-58,149-151]
|
|-- Runtime application holder: apprt.App -- application/embedding lifetime
|   [src/main_ghostty.zig:100-107; src/apprt/embedded.zig:1714-1748]
|   |-- Full application configuration and runtime input/platform state
|   |   Embedded App.init clones Config; config-change replaces it; keymap is lazy.
|   |   terminate releases config/keymap. GTK Application retains its config object
|   |   and platform event/UI state until runtime teardown.
|   |   [src/apprt/embedded.zig:139-174,349; src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:177-180,1253]
|   `-- -> Core App: runtime retains a pointer; entry/C API coordinates its destruction.
|       App.updateConfig borrows caller config only during propagation; surfaces derive copies.
|       [src/App.zig:168-200; src/apprt/embedded.zig:1739-1748]
|
`-- Runtime surface owners -- one per terminal pane; lifetime controlled by native UI/host
    [src/apprt/embedded.zig:447-519,634-646;
     src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:1963-1980,3557-3624]
    |-- Runtime-local title, geometry, cursor/platform state and optional inspector UI
    |   Embedded Surface.init initializes state; callbacks update it; deinit frees title/UI.
    |   GTK's GObject surface retains its native widgets and per-surface configuration.
    |   -> Runtime application holder: surface.app / Application.default(), not a second owner.
    `-- core_surface: Surface -- initialized by runtime; deinitialized before its storage is released
        [src/Surface.zig:477-890]
        Embedded runtime stores it inline; GTK allocates it and destroys it in finalize.
        Teardown stops/joins search, renderer, then IO before destroying shared session state.
        |-- Session/input/configuration state
        |   id, size, focus/visibility/read-only/child-exit flags, mouse/selection gesture,
        |   keyboard sequence queue/table stack, font size/metrics and DerivedConfig.
        |   Input callbacks and config/resize events change these; deinit releases queues,
        |   gesture tracking and derived config after workers stop.
        |   [src/Surface.zig:69-188,829-887; DerivedConfig.init/deinit]
        |   |-- Font-grid lease: font_grid_key
        |   |   init refs a grid; setFontSize refs replacement and queues a handoff.
        |   |   Renderer accepts replacement and derefs old key; Surface.deinit derefs current key.
        |   |   [src/Surface.zig:528-535,2536-2573,877-878]
        |   |   `-- -> Core App.font_grid_set: actual grids remain set-owned.
        |   `-- -> Core App and runtime app/surface: borrowed backpointers in Surface.
        |
        |-- io: termio.Termio -- owns the live terminal session, not the renderer
        |   Surface.init transfers backend, mailbox and derived config into Termio.init.
        |   Surface.deinit calls io.deinit only after IO and renderer joins.
        |   [src/Surface.zig:693-734,829-864; src/termio/Termio.zig:254-365]
        |   |-- terminal: terminal.Terminal -- authoritative mutable emulation state
        |   |   Initialized to configured grid size; PTY output, resize/config and UI selection
        |   |   mutate it under Surface.renderer_state.mutex; Termio.deinit destroys it.
        |   |   [src/termio/Termio.zig:275-304,466,705-714]
        |   |   |-- Modes, colors/palette, dimensions, tabstops, title/pwd and protocol registrations
        |   |   |   Escape sequences update state; Terminal.deinit frees owned dynamic storage.
        |   |   |   [src/terminal/Terminal.zig:48-165,344-404]
        |   |   `-- screens: ScreenSet -- creates primary immediately; other screens lazily
        |   |       getInit creates; switchTo changes active reference; remove/deinit destroy screens.
        |   |       [src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig:38-110]
        |   |       |-- Screen instances: cursor/saved cursor, selection, charset and keyboard state
        |   |       |   [src/terminal/Screen.zig:38-87,315-370]
        |   |       |   |-- pages: PageList -- active grid and bounded scrollback storage
        |   |       |   |   Owns pages, tracking pins, viewport and page pool. Output grows/prunes;
        |   |       |   |   resize reflows; compression changes storage; deinit releases pages/pool.
        |   |       |   |   [src/terminal/PageList.zig:402-510; init, deinit, resize, grow]
        |   |       |   `-- kitty_images -- per-screen image/placement storage when enabled
        |   |       |       Initialized with limits; protocol commands update it; Screen.deinit frees it.
        |   |       |       [src/terminal/Screen.zig:348-370]
        |   |       `-- -> ScreenSet.all: active points to one of the already-owned screens.
        |   |-- terminal_stream: StreamHandler.Stream -- persistent parser/protocol state
        |   |   init creates; reader feeds PTY output; deinit clears parser/handler resources.
        |   |   [src/termio/Termio.zig:317-365,705; src/termio/stream_handler.zig]
        |   |   `-- -> Termio.terminal and Surface.renderer_state: handler borrows both.
        |   |-- backend.exec: Exec.Subprocess -- command/environment and PTY/process ownership
        |   |   Exec.init prepares command/cwd/environment; threadEnter starts PTY and child.
        |   |   resize updates PTY geometry; threadExit stops child; deinit closes PTY and
        |   |   frees retained environment/command arena. Child exit need not close the surface.
        |   |   [src/termio/Exec.zig:45-61,86-105,196-229,596-624,887-900,1107-1160]
        |   |-- mailbox: termio.Mailbox -- transferred SPSC queue and wakeup handle
        |   |   queueIo transfers messages; IO consumes them; message.deinit frees owned payloads.
        |   |   mailbox.deinit drains leftovers and releases queue/wakeup resources.
        |   |   [src/Surface.zig:901-924; src/termio/mailbox.zig:47-52; message.zig:120-126]
        |   |-- DerivedConfig, size and optional ThreadEnterState
        |   |   Config replacements free prior copies. Initial input setup is consumed/destroyed
        |   |   during threadEnter; deinit frees it if entry never consumed it.
        |   |   [src/termio/Termio.zig:354-397,466]
        |   `-- -> Surface.renderer_state, renderer_thread.mailbox/wakeup and Core App.mailbox
        |       Synchronization/notification references do not transfer their ownership.
        |
        |-- io_thread: termio.Thread and io_thr -- Surface starts and joins the OS worker
        |   [src/Surface.zig:610-612,761-767,843-861]
        |   |-- Event loop, stop handle, scroll/resize-coalescing/synchronized-output timers
        |   |   Thread.init allocates; callbacks update; Thread.deinit releases after join.
        |   |   [src/termio/Thread.zig:92-133]
        |   |-- Worker-lifetime CallbackData / Termio.ThreadData
        |   |   Stack-retained by threadMain_; threadEnter initializes backend resources;
        |   |   deferred threadExit then ThreadData.deinit release them before worker returns.
        |   |   [src/termio/Thread.zig:259-273]
        |   |   |-- Exec.ThreadData: process watcher, write stream/queue/pool and termios timer
        |   |   |   Writes remain stable until completion, then return to pool; deinit frees pool/handles.
        |   |   |   [src/termio/Exec.zig:493-565]
        |   |   `-- PTY reader thread and shutdown pipe
        |   |       Exec.threadEnter spawns; reader feeds Termio.processOutput under state lock.
        |   |       Exec.threadExit stops child, signals pipe and joins reader before data cleanup.
        |   |       -> Termio.backend.exec.subprocess: PTY/process are owned there, not by reader.
        |   |       [src/termio/Exec.zig:119-168,196-229; src/termio/Termio.zig:705-714]
        |   `-- -> Surface.io: worker borrows Termio and its mailbox for its entire run.
        |
        |-- renderer_state: renderer.State -- Surface-owned synchronization and UI overlay state
        |   Mutex allocated at Surface.init; preedit storage changes with IME input;
        |   mouse/demand/handoff fields coordinate readers/writers. Surface.deinit frees mutex/preedit.
        |   [src/renderer/State.zig:17-45; src/Surface.zig:597-601,880-883,2669]
        |   |-- -> Termio.terminal: shared terminal pointer, not a second terminal allocation.
        |   `-- -> Surface.inspector: optional borrowed inspector pointer.
        |
        |-- renderer: Renderer -- per-surface rendering state, initialized before workers start
        |   [src/Surface.zig:578-595; src/renderer/generic.zig:712,841-874]
        |   |-- CPU render snapshot, cells, shaping/cache state, search-result arenas and DerivedConfig
        |   |   updateFrame refreshes snapshot/cells; messages replace config/results;
        |   |   renderer.deinit frees CPU state after renderer worker joins.
        |   |   [src/renderer/generic.zig:1371,2171,841-874]
        |   |-- GraphicsAPI state, swap chain/frame resources, shaders and image resources
        |   |   Created for display/drawing; hide/unrealize can release swap chain for later rebuild.
        |   |   threadExit releases GPU/images before API context teardown; deinit releases API state.
        |   |   [src/renderer/generic.zig:321-332,395-460,911-943,1244-1256]
        |   |-- latest_frame -- optional retained exported frame for toolkit compositing
        |   |   New export releases prior frame; deinit releases remaining frame.
        |   |   [src/renderer/generic.zig:126-134,1045]
        |   |-- display_link -- macOS-only, lazily created for vsync
        |   |   Renderer.deinit closes it before renderer_thread destroys its callback target.
        |   |   -> Surface.renderer_thread.draw_now: borrowed notification handle.
        |   |   [src/renderer/generic.zig:853-866,1267-1298]
        |   |-- -> Core App.device and font_grid_set: device/font data are shared, not duplicated.
        |   `-- -> Surface.renderer_state: snapshot acquisition borrows protected terminal state.
        |
        |-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread and renderer_thr -- Surface starts/joins render worker
        |   Surface joins before renderer.deinit, then releases Thread resources.
        |   [src/Surface.zig:753-759,833-860]
        |   |-- Event loop, mailbox, wakeup/stop/draw handles, render/cursor/compression timers,
        |   |   and thread-derived configuration
        |   |   init creates; messages/timers update; deinit destroys resources after join.
        |   |   [src/renderer/Thread.zig:116-190]
        |   `-- -> Surface.renderer, renderer_state and runtime surface: borrowed worker targets.
        |
        |-- search: ?Surface.Search -- optional search session, created on first nonempty query
        |   Owns worker handle plus terminal.search.Thread; query/navigation messages change search.
        |   Empty query/end_search or Surface.deinit stops, joins and deinitializes it first.
        |   [src/Surface.zig:210-229,5080-5143]
        |   |-- Search engine/results, mailbox, event loop, refresh timer and async handles
        |   |   Thread.deinit releases search state under terminal mutex, then no search pins remain.
        |   |   [src/terminal/search/Thread.zig:46-79,84-130]
        |   `-- -> Termio.terminal and Surface.renderer_state.mutex: borrowed for search lifetime.
        |
        `-- inspector: ?*Inspector -- optional core inspection session
            activateInspector allocates; deactivateInspector or Surface.deinit destroys it.
            [src/Surface.zig:929; activateInspector, deactivateInspector, deinit]
            `-- gui/widget inspection state and recorded input events
                Inspector.init/deinit creates/releases state; recordKeyEvent updates event history.
                [src/inspector/Inspector.zig:19-22,58-85]"}
